description: Read-only Windows diagnostics with Event Log, System Health, inventory, reports and a local AI assistant; requires PulseService.
pre_install: if (Get-Process -Name 'Pulse' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close Pulse before installing or updating it through Scoop.' }
if (-not $pathMatch.Success) { throw 'PulseService is registered, but its executable path could not be identified. Refusing to overwrite an unknown service installation.' }

if (-not $registeredExe.StartsWith($appRoot, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw ('PulseService is already registered outside this Scoop-managed installation: {0}. Uninstall that Pulse copy before using the Scoop package.' -f $registeredExe) }
post_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $serviceExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'PulseService.exe is missing from the Pulse payload.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw ('PulseService refresh failed with exit code {0}.' -f $process.ExitCode) }
pre_uninstall: if (Get-Process -Name 'Pulse' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close Pulse before uninstalling it through Scoop; the service has not been removed.' }
if (-not $pathMatch.Success) { throw 'PulseService is registered, but its executable path could not be identified. Refusing to remove an unknown service installation.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $serviceExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Could not find PulseService.exe to remove the Scoop-managed service.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw ('PulseService removal failed with exit code {0}.' -f $process.ExitCode) }
Write-Warning 'PulseService is registered outside this Scoop installation; leaving that service untouched.'
notes: The release ZIP is a payload, not a true portable edition. A fresh Scoop install does not register or start PulseService; use Pulse's in-app Repair / Install service action and approve UAC. During Scoop updates, the service is refreshed only if it was already registered for this Scoop installation. Scoop does not install Visual C++ Runtime automatically. If PulseService fails to start because the runtime is missing, install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable x64 manually: https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe. Scoop uninstall removes the service only when its registered executable belongs to this Scoop installation. Close Pulse before installing, updating or uninstalling through Scoop. User settings and logs remain under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pulse.
